mapper.sql: id, task_code, task_type, task_title, task_description, impact_scope, status, submitted_by, submitted_at, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, review_comment, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_system_task (id, task_code, task_type, task_title, task_description, impact_scope, status, submitted_by) VALUES (#{task.id}, #{task.code}, #{task.type}, #{task.title}, #{task.description}, #{task.impactScope}, #{task.status}, #{task.submittedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_system_task SET status = #{status}, submitted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE sys_system_task SET status = #{status}, reviewed_by = #{reviewerId}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, review_comment = #{comment}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_REVIEW'
UPDATE sys_system_task SET status = 'EFFECTIVE', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'APPROVED'
